intro: Buzzbox 411 is an Alliance quest found along the windswept coastline of Darkshore. Operating through an eccentric mechanical relay network, the intoxicated gnome inventor Wizbang Cranktoggle enlists travelers to gather coastal thresher eyes to bring his second research machine back online.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.
"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach
So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... Sorry about that...
Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. What? No, I'm fine!"

clips.title: Progress
paras: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.
"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"
You believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
